integrity: The proof starts from the published fine-harmonic-triple vertex formula and enumeration, identifies the source parameter b with the sum of the two positions of the distinguished label, derives the shell radii and multiplicities exactly, and proves minimum-enclosing optimality and uniqueness through the positive equal-weight barycenter of the outer contact shell. Finite enumeration is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the standard Ardila--Escobar coordinate realization for n>=2 and its inherited Euclidean metric. It determines the complete centered vertex-shell distribution and unique minimum enclosing sphere, but not the full pairwise distance spectrum, John ellipsoid, or Loewner ellipsoid. A residual originality risk remains for an equivalent metric observation derived independently from the published vertex formula.
title: Harmonic-polytope vertices form exactly n Euclidean shells
